materialOpportunity: Make the first real-attorney cohort and lawful profile-growth workflow operable without relying on paid enrollment or automatic trust decisions.
implemented: Free-profile-first cohort plan and contact queue
Private unclaimed candidate commit with provenance
Portal suggestions without automatic specialty approval
sharedLearning: Free basic profile control should be the first attorney acquisition offer; paid growth remains optional and separately gated.
Source provenance and supported-field declarations should be captured before profile candidates are created.
Fast profile growth must not collapse identity, credential, specialty, publication, ranking or payment states.
Workers’ Compensation and Medical Malpractice must not be silently absorbed into Personal Injury.
Public attorney outreach should collect professional contact data only, not client stories or confidential matter facts.
nextValidation: Lawful source authorization and batch review rehearsal
